- No acute focal airspace disease, consolidation, or pneumothorax was detected in the lungs.
- Chronic findings such as calcified granulomas are present in several reports, representing old granulomatous disease.
- Rib deformities were noted in one case, though no acute fractures were identified in any of the examinations.
- One instance of costophrenic sulcus blunting was reported as either a small effusion or scarring, leaving that finding uncertain.
